rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday choice when something alarms or upsets someone.

example.english: That sudden loud noise did unnerve me.
example.traditional: 嗰一下突然嘅巨響真係嚇親我。
example.jyutping: go2 jat1 haa5 dat6 jin4 ge3 geoi6 hoeng2 zan1 hai6 haak3 can1 ngo5

rows.jyutping: gaau2 dou3 A hou2 gan2 zoeng1
rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on making someone nervous or tense rather than frightening them suddenly.

example.english: Having an interview tomorrow is going to unnerve me.
example.traditional: 聽日要見工，搞到我好緊張。
example.jyutping: ting1 jat6 jiu3 gin3 gung1 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 hou2 gan2 zoeng1

rows.jyutping: dung6 jiu4 A ge3 seon3 sam1
rows.note: Use this when the event shakes someone's confidence or resolve, not merely their nerves.

example.english: The repeated failures have begun to unnerve me.
example.traditional: 連續幾次失敗，已經動搖我嘅信心。
example.jyutping: lin4 zuk6 gei2 ci3 sat1 baai6 ji5 ging1 dung6 jiu4 ngo5 ge3 seon3 sam1
